crew.overview: When a Delta Force special ops mission goes terribly wrong, Air Force drone pilot Reaper has 48 hours to remedy what has devolved into a wild rescue operation. With no weapons and no communication other than the drone above, the ground mission suddenly becomes a full-scale battle when the team is discovered by the enemy.
crew.title: Land of Bad

details.biography: Agustin Claramunt is an Uruguayan cinematographer. He graduated from UCUDAL and holds a Master's degree in Cinematography (Escuela Superior de Cine y Audiovisuales de Cataluña).
details.name: Agustin Claramunt
